04 / Malaysia · My teenage years

First flight abroad. First solo adventure.

No one in my family had ever travelled internationally. So taking my first international trip as a teenager felt like a pretty big deal. My journey around the Model United Nations summit in Bali also took me to Malaysia, where I spent over four days exploring a completely new place on my own. Different people, different cultures, different ways of living. It taught me to be more independent, humble, empathetic, and curious about the world beyond my own. Four days in a new country. A perspective I'll carry for life.
